title: BundleV2Members
description: DRAFT until ADR 0067 is Accepted (F8-WO1). The members ADR 0067 adds to a v2 run's records: `RunManifest`'s (D2) and `ReplayReport`'s (D5, ADR 0019 Amendment 12). `run-manifest.schema.json` reaches each by a `$ref`, so that the `sha256` names they declare live in a schema F8's numerical-policy addendum covers and ADR 0025 D2.3's partition holds with v2's data unchanged (R-1032's structure). Every member is optional in the documents that use it; a v1-path run carries none of them (D1).

bundle_format.description: D2: its presence selects D5's reader. Non-structural (`NON_STRUCTURAL`).

data_lock.description: D2: `data_lock_sha256`, ADR 0061 D10's SHA of the run's data lock (`artifacts/data-lock.json` hashes to it, D3). Structural, R0. A fragment of the manifest's top level, joined by `allOf`.

extensions_used.description: D2: ADR 0060 D8's extensions used, derived from the run's documents, built-ins included: one `[kind, id, version, descriptor_sha256, self_sha256]` row per descriptor, sorted by (kind, id, version key), each at most once (`run.manifest_v2.extensions_used_rows`). Structural, R0, top level (D2's departure from ADR 0060 D9).

run_kind.description: D2, ADR 0066 D11: the run kind of a `run` job, `[id, version]`. Structural, R0. Nothing in 0.6 writes it.

documents.description: D2, ADR 0066 D11: a `run` job's documents, `{<role>: sha256}`. Structural, R0. Nothing in 0.6 writes it.

environment_registry.description: D2: `environment.registry`, the registry the run saw: ADR 0060 D10's `registry_sha256` and the SHA of its snapshot document (`artifacts/registry-snapshot.json`, D3). Non-structural (in `environment`).

registry_comparison.description: D5 step 5 (Amendment 12): the recorded and the current registry, the used extensions that changed or are missing (`[kind, id, version]`), and how many descriptors the run did not use differ.

data_availability.description: D5 step 6 (Amendment 12): how many of the lock's records came from the bundle and from the local store, and the SHAs that resolved from neither, sorted.
